 While every team in the NFC East has struggled so far in 2026, the Dallas Cowboys have the fewest excuses. 
 But they have a chance to change the momentum of their season on ‘Monday Night Football,’ taking on an injury-riddled Philadelphia Eagles squad quarterbacked by Tanner McKee. If Dallas is going to get back in the win column, a big game from CeeDee Lamb would go a long way. 
 Ahead of their third prime-time contest in a row, Lamb explained why he thinks Dallas can take control of the division. 
 “Anybody can win this division, so why not us? We know what we’re messing up and our areas of improvement are,”  he said.   
 “I feel like we have the best roster top down, and we have to go out there and play like that on Sundays and Mondays.”
 Since he caught 17 passes for 189 yards and a touchdown in their Week 4 win over Houston, Lamb was held to two catches for nine yards against the previously-winless Bucs and was kept out of the end zone once again in the 23-13 loss to Green Bay in Week 6. 
 Which brings us today’s quiz. Since falling to the Cowboys at 17-overall in the 2020 NFL Draft, Lamb has been one of the most productive wide receivers in the league, setting a Dallas record for both catches and yards in a single season in 2023. With that being said, can you name the players with the most receiving yards in one season for each NFL franchise?
 Good luck!
